answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique taxi medallion shifts flips the bet — shifts logged under one medallion for years — and the garden lands on the attacker instead. What makes this stick is that shifts logged under one medallion for years cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the shale of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the river of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
